assets.subject: a simple wooden tavern chair
assets.detail: Plain sturdy chair with four thick square legs, chunky stretchers between the legs, a flat plank seat and a low back of two broad slats; honey-colored wood with warm painted gradients.

assets.subject: a standing wooden barrel
assets.detail: Upright barrel with broad staves, three thick blue-gray iron hoops, a closed round lid with a chunky rim; slightly swollen belly; gentle wear on the hoops.

assets.subject: a pewter drinking tankard
assets.detail: Squat lidded tankard with a thick hinged lid, a large looped handle with a thumb rest, two raised bands around the body; soft blue-gray pewter with a little ochre foam peeking under the lid.

assets.subject: a small heap of turnips
assets.detail: About six plump turnips piled together, cream-white bodies blushing to rich burgundy-purple at the top, with short thick moss-green leaf stubs; chunky, readable, each turnip clearly separated.
